subject: Shiny evaluates even before it runs - how to get rid of an error message?

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: Shiny evaluates even before it runs - how to get rid of an error message?
parts:
I apologize in advance that I am not providing reproducible code. But I hope my question can be answered as a more general one.

I have a 'ui.r' file and 'server.r' code that work (see the relevant parts of it below). But here is what my question is about.
As you can see, there is nothing in 'bigone' below that is isolated. There is isolation happening under 'renderPlot'.
However, when I start testing - BEFORE I even start making any input selections, I get an error message in red on my main Panel in Chrome:

Error: Attention: You have to upload the input files starting with your utils!

So, it looks like for some reason Shiny starts evaluating everything under shinySever even before I hit my 'Run' button (goButton).
How can I prevent Shiny from doing anything until I hit my goButton?
Thanks a lot!

Dimitri


############################################################################
# IN MY 'server.r' CODE I HAVE:

shinyServer(function(input,output){
  
  # Defining the big thing 'bigone' that calculates everything based on inputs provided:
  
  bigone<-reactive({
    
    inFile1<-input$utils                # one of my inputs in ui.r has the name 'utils'
    if(is.null(inFile1)) stop("Attention: You have to upload the input files starting with your utils!")
  ...
  ...
  ...
    result<-list(medians=mymedians, ...,  ...)
    return(result)  # code end; return list with 3 elements
  })

   
  # Creating a plot:
  output$medians.plot1 <- renderPlot({
    input$goButton
    # Isolating:
    isolate(
      print(ggplot(bigone()$medians,aes(x=reorder(att_levels, WTP), y=WTP)) + 
        .........      )
    )
  })

})


############################################################################
# IN MY 'ui.r' CODE I HAVE:


shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title:
  headerPanel("My Application"),
  
  # Sidebar with controls to select the inputs:

  sidebarPanel(
    
    fileInput('utils','Upload your file with utils:'),                      # input is called 'utils'
     ...
     ...
    actionButton("goButton","Run")
  ),
  
  # Define Main Panel (with tabs):
  
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Plot1",  plotOutput("medians.plot1",height="600px")),
    tabPanel("Plot 2", plotOutput("medians.plot2",height="600px"))
    
    )
  )
))
